svg.text: StackChan, brain v4: a spiking stimulus analyzer and one decision network
M5Stack CoreS3 / ESP32-S3 - 20 Hz tick (50 ms): channels and SNN every tick, the main network every 2nd tick - everything runs on the robot; the home PC records and trains
Channel encoder: 13 channels, each a number 0..1
soft zone borders (±0.03); innate table, may shift ±0.15 with experience;
innate tolerance: alarm only at ~2x the stimulus
slow clocks (minutes, hours) stay in code: a spiking net cannot count them
on the robot and in the trainer: the same code (parity test, error 0)
12 x 8 attention map: where to look
2 substeps of 25 ms per tick, event-driven C++
int8 weights per row: 236 KB (in PSRAM)
3-5 ms per tick on the ESP32-S3
· trained: surrogate gradients, TBPTT, int8 QAT
input 44 = 32 from the SNN + 12 own state
runs at 10 Hz, float, 31 k parameters
last mood, how long the face is shown,
time since a sound / a gesture, head pose,
LED level, was the touch answered,
· trained: imitation of a teacher with
reactions may spend the last one
nod / shake at most every 4 s
each mood its own head motion;
nod YES, shake NO, flinch, doze
Home PC (192.168.8.110): records every tick, learns at night, sends firmware and what the robot learned
6 Night sleep 03:30: learning from its own life (sleep_v4.py)
replay every decision from the diary -> reward by people's answers (petting, talk, coming close / shaking, rough pokes, leaving) -> AWR on the action heads -> zones shift (habituation, ±0.15)
-> gates (behaviour tests in the simulator) -> learned blob to the robot, switched in without a reboot; the SNN and the emotions stay innate
the teachers exist only on the PC
The firmware holds only brain v4 and what it learned (zone shifts, action heads); the PC records, analyses and trains. No camera frames or sound leave the robot.
The simulator runs the real firmware code (channels, SNN, NN, executor) in a virtual room with scripted people, sounds, touches and light.
